slice: R2.6.27 snapshot-bound vault link resolution API
status: accepted cross-layer resolver API slice; R2 remains in progress
scope: Resolve all parsed Markdown references in a note through the production document resolver and a stable, root-confined vault snapshot; expose the operation through VaultSession and exercise it with the shared C03 link-resolution fixture.
behavior: VaultRoot::resolve_links_for_note requires an existing regular Markdown note, reads Markdown sources through the confined vault reader, and uses regular vault files as candidates while excluding symlinks.
The resolver is bound to matching before/after vault snapshots and returns LinkResolutionSnapshotChanged if the vault changes during resolution; it performs no writes.
VaultSession exposes the operation and the engine crate reexports the result and link-resolution types.

The testkit materializes the shared fixture, compares parsed reference fields, status, target and candidate paths with expected results, and verifies both the snapshot and every original file byte remain unchanged.
